lines.en: I find myself alongside my slightly wonderful (but mostly annoying) kouhai on the way back from another uneventful day at school.
lines.zh: 我发现自己和那位略带可爱(但主要还是烦人)的学妹并肩走在放学路上——又是平平无奇的一天。

lines.en: Or at least what was an uneventful day up until the very end of it, when I was somehow suckered into assisting Imani and some of the other girls in cleaning the pool.
lines.zh: 或者至少,在一天将尽之前都平平无奇——天知道我怎么被忽悠去帮 Imani 和其他几个女孩清洗泳池的。

lines.en: But that isn’t what I’ve decided to share with you today.
lines.zh: 但这不是我今天打算分享的事。

lines.en: What I have decided to share is the tail end of a long walk to the bar after a hard day’s work because it’s moments like these where my mind begins to wander.
lines.zh: 我打算分享的,是辛苦一天之后走向酒吧的长路尾声——因为正是在这种时刻,我的思绪开始游离。

lines.en: And as it detaches itself from the inside of my skull and saunters off down alleys unexplored, I must summon the me who once was to take over in its stead.
lines.zh: 而当它从我的颅骨内剥离、独自溜进未经探索的小巷时,我必须召唤出「曾经的我」来接管一切。

lines.en: But that “me” overcomplicates things.
lines.zh: 但那个「我」,总是把事情复杂化。

lines.en: It turns otherwise pleasant moments upside down when it remembers that it and we are undeserving of quiet moments like this.
lines.zh: 一旦它记起「它和我们不配拥有这样安静的时刻」,那些原本愉快的瞬间就会被掀个底朝天。

lines.en: We’re undeserving of long walks to the bar or bubble tea or the pruning of our hands after soaking them in soap and water for hours on end.
lines.zh: 我们不配走向酒吧的长路,不配珍珠奶茶,不配在肥皂水里泡了几个小时之后,指腹发皱。

lines.en: But no one cares what we do or don’t deserve. No one cares if things are complicated or not.
lines.zh: 可没有人在乎我们配不配。没有人在乎事情复杂不复杂。

lines.en: All that we want is to watch one thing transform into something else. That’s what keeps life fresh. That’s what keeps our interactions notable.
lines.zh: 我们想要的,只是看着一件事变成另一件事。这才让生活保鲜。这才让我们的互动值得一提。

lines.en: So I will disguise myself as a passable human being and communicate with this girl in a way that is mostly normal, but fractionally strange based on an unwanted substitute...
lines.zh: 所以,我会把自己伪装成一个还过得去的人,以基本正常、却因一记不请自来的替代品而略显古怪的方式,和这个女孩交谈……

lines.en: It’ll be fine, though.
lines.zh: 不过会没事的。

lines.en: Everything will be fine.
lines.zh: 一切都会没事的。

lines.en: She’ll laugh and smile and flirt and laugh again because that is what she does as a slightly wonderful (but mostly annoying) kouhai. Which is, again, fine.
lines.zh: 她会笑,会微笑,会调情,然后再笑——因为这就是一个略带可爱(但主要还是烦人)的学妹的做派。再说一遍,这没事。

lines.en: But it’s not what anyone wants to see.
lines.zh: 只是这不是任何人想看的。

lines.en: What we want is the closing of a gap between two people who would be better off remaining three feet apart in perpetuity, because that closure breaks the silence.
lines.zh: 我们想看的,是两个本该永远保持三英尺距离的人之间的缝隙闭合——因为闭合打破了沉默。

lines.en: It interrupts our walk.
lines.zh: 它打断了我们的散步。

lines.en: And it lays down the foundation of the real story here. Not just the one we got conned into watching after pressing the wrong button on a metaphorical TV remote.
lines.zh: 它为这里真正要说的事打下地基——而不只是我们在隐喻的电视遥控器上按错按钮、被骗着看完的那个故事。

lines.en: Why can I not just walk home in peace?
lines.zh: 为什么我就不能安安静静地回家?

lines.en: Why does everything have to be an event?
lines.zh: 为什么一切都必须成为一场「事件」?

lines.en: : Senpai. Tell me a joke.
lines.zh: : Senpai。讲个笑话。

lines.en: : Knock knock.
lines.zh: : 叮咚。

lines.en: : Who’s there?
lines.zh: : 谁呀?

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有人。

lines.en: : No who?
lines.zh: : 没有谁呀?

lines.en: : That was it, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 刚才那个就是笑话,对吧?

lines.en: : Funny, right?
lines.zh: : 好笑吧?

lines.en: : No! And why did you make me knock if you were just going to turn me away?
lines.zh: : 不好笑!再说你既然要把我拒之门外,为什么要让我敲门?

lines.en: : Because your disappointment is funny to me and comedy is subjective. It’s not my fault if you don’t laugh.
lines.zh: : 因为你的失望在我眼里很好笑,而喜剧是主观的。你不笑,可不能怪我。

lines.en: : Mm.
: Knock knock.
lines.zh: : 叮咚。

lines.en: : I’m not falling for it again, Senpai. We can just go back to talking about boring normal stuff since that’s apparently all you’re capable of.
lines.zh: : 我不会再上当了,Senpai。我们还是回去聊无聊的正常话题吧——反正那显然是你的能力上限。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not as if we can make idle chit-chat about how our day was when we spent the entire thing together.
lines.zh: : 嗯,可我们俩一整天都待在一起,连「今天过得怎么样」这种闲聊都聊不成了。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong here, but I’m pretty sure that falls into “boring normal stuff.” Tell me something interesting. As my elder, isn’t it your job to keep me entertained on long walks like this?
lines.zh: : 如果我说错了请纠正,但我很确定那正好归入「无聊的正常话题」。讲点有意思的。作为长辈,在这种长路上逗我开心,不就是你的职责吗?

lines.en: : Uhh...no? As the younger, more energetic teacher here, shouldn’t you be the one keeping things “entertaining” while I just...nod and say something mildly sexual every once in a while?
lines.zh: : 呃……不是?身为这里更年轻、更有活力的老师,不该由你负责「有趣」,而我只在旁边点头、时不时说点 Mild 级的荤话吗?

lines.en: : Maybe. But you haven’t even done that. And if you bring that attitude to the bar, the rest of the girls are going to wind up kicking you out of the friend group no matter how hard I try to stop them.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。可你连这个都没做。你要是带着这副态度去酒吧,无论我怎么拦,其他女孩最后都会把你踢出朋友团。

lines.en: : I think I’ll be okay. Despite what little time we’ve all shared together, I think we’re a pretty tight-knit group by now. Besides, my role as the token male would be hard to just outright replace.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我没事。尽管我们相处的时间不长,可我觉得我们现在已经相当团结了。再说,「团队专属男性」这个角色,可不是说换就能换的。

lines.en: : Ooh! Then that means my role as the token “young one” will be hard to outright replace too! Hooray for us! We’re both-
lines.zh: : 哦噢!那也就是说,「团队专属小年轻」这个角色也很难换!万岁!我们都是——

lines.en: : Wait. You thought I was going to say something else just now, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 等等,你刚才以为我要说别的,对不对?

lines.en: : I literally didn’t even move my mouth.
lines.zh: : 我嘴压根都没动。

lines.en: : Likely story! Now, either tell me a joke or I’m quitting Kumon-mi High and getting a job in the sinkhole.
lines.zh: : 编,接着编!要么讲个笑话,要么我马上从 Kumon-mi 高中辞职,去天坑里找份工作!

lines.en: : It was nice working with you, Imani. Sorry we never got to make out.
lines.zh: : 跟你共事很愉快,Imani。遗憾我们始终没亲热成。

lines.en: : Don’t be. You’re not missing much if Rika’s scale is anywhere near the same as yours.
lines.zh: : 别遗憾。要是 Rika 的评分标准和你差不多,你根本没错过什么。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if it’s rude to say this or not, but I’m pretty sure her scale is a lot...larger than mine.
lines.zh: : 我不确定这么说礼不礼貌,但我很确定,她的评分标准……比我「大」得多。

lines.en: : It would have been a little less rude without the awkward pause and emphasis placed on larger. But yeah...you’re probably not wrong.
lines.zh: : 去掉那个尴尬的停顿、和念「大」字时的重音,这话会没那么失礼。不过……嗯,你多半没说错。

lines.en: : Just don’t repeat that to her, okay? She’s a little sensitive when it comes to people pointing out her past and...you’re looking away from me.
lines.zh: : 千万别把这话告诉她,好吗?一有人提她的过去,她就有点敏感,而且……你把头别过去了。

lines.en: : You already did that, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你已经说过了,对吧?

lines.en: : Not...purposely.
lines.zh: : 不算……故意的。

lines.en: : Hah...what am I going to do with you?
lines.zh: : 哈……我拿你怎么办呢?

lines.en: : As if taking over in school isn’t already enough, it’s like you want me to take over in-
lines.zh: : 在学校接手我的班还不够,你这是想连那方面也接手——

lines.en: : Wait, hold that thought. That’s probably one of the girls right now.
lines.zh: : 等等,先记住这个思路。现在打来的大概是某个女孩。

lines.en: : How can I hold your thought? That’s not how that works.
lines.zh: : 「记住你的思路」要怎么操作?没这种运作方式吧。

lines.en: : Hello?...
: Oh, hey! I was actually just talking about you...
lines.zh: : 哦,嘿!我们正好在说你……

lines.en: : No...It wasn’t about how much you like pizza. And I’m not sure why you would have assumed that, but...what’s up?
lines.zh: : 不……不是聊我有多喜欢披萨。我也不知道你为什么会以为那个……怎么了?

lines.en: : Wait, really?...
lines.zh: : 等等,真的?……

lines.en: : Like...not at all?
lines.zh: : 就是说……一个都不来?

lines.en: As Imani converses with who I can only imagine is Rika, my phone begins to ring as well...
lines.zh: 当 Imani 和我推断只能是 Rika 的人通话时,我的手机也响了……

lines.en: : Hello?
: Arakawa — I need you to listen carefully.
lines.zh: : Arakawa——听仔细了。

lines.en: : You are being set up.
lines.zh: : 你被设计了。

lines.en: : ...What?

: I am a good friend who has not revealed any of the things you said to me the other night about your childhood friend or your feelings concerning Imani, so I want you to know this has nothing to do with me.
lines.zh: : 我是个好朋友,那天晚上你说的关于你青梅竹马的事、你对 Imani 的感受,我一个字都没有外传。所以我想让你知道,这与我无关。

lines.en: : And also that I am sorry. I tried.
lines.zh: : 还有,对不起。我试过了。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure what-
lines.zh: : 我不太明白——

lines.en: : No one else is coming to the bar. It is a calculated effort coordinated by Osako and Rika to get you and Imani alone together. I had no part in this.
lines.zh: : 没有其他人会去酒吧了。这是 Osako 和 Rika 联手策划的行动,好让你和 Imani 独处。我没有参与。

lines.en: : ...Uh-huh.
: Ah. So that’s what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 啊。原来是这么回事。

lines.en: : It won’t be a problem, will it? The two of you being alone together.
lines.zh: : 不会成为问题,对吧?你们俩独处这件事。

lines.en: : Not at all. But thanks for letting me know you had nothing to do with it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 完全不会。不过还是谢谢你特意声明此事与你无关。

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Just also know that I am not opposed to the idea of you having sex with her. In fact, if it were not for your “feelings,” I would say that would be the best outcome possible.
lines.zh: : 另外也请记住,我并不反对你和她上床的设想。事实上,若不是因为你那些「感受」,我会说那才是最好的结局。

lines.en: : I’ll keep that in mind, Wakana. Goodnight.
lines.zh: : 我记下了,Wakana。晚安。

lines.en: : Wait, Arakawa — there’s one more thing.
lines.zh: : 等等,Arakawa——还有一件事。

lines.en: : There always is. What is it this time?
lines.zh: : 永远都有。这次是什么?

lines.en: : Nothing important. Just that-
lines.zh: : 不重要。只是——

lines.en: : I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我真他妈想死。

lines.en: Both of us hang up the phone and...I accept that tonight’s “silence” is going to be broken in even more ways than I initially expected.
lines.zh: 我们俩各自挂断电话,然后……我接受了这个事实:今晚的「安静」,将以比我预想中更多的方式被打破。

lines.en: : So, uhh...looks like it’s just gonna be you and me tonight.
lines.zh: : 那么,呃……看来今晚就只剩你和我了。

lines.en: : Still down?
lines.zh: : 还有兴致吗?

lines.en: : We’ve been alone a million times before. Why should this be any different?
lines.zh: : 我们独处过一百万次了。这次能有什么不同?

lines.en: : Exactly! This is just another night. Just two friends going out to the bar for drinks. Nothing weird about it unless we make it weird, right?
lines.zh: : 正是!这只是一个普通的夜晚。只是两个朋友出去喝一杯。只要我们不把它弄怪,它就不怪,对吧?

lines.en: : You’re starting to get close to making it weird, Imani.
lines.zh: : 你已经在把它弄怪的边缘了,Imani。

lines.en: : No. You’re making things weird by saying that I’m starting to make things weird. Come on, Senpai. You should know better than that.
lines.zh: : 不。是我把它弄怪的,因为你非要说我把它弄怪。拜托,Senpai。你该比这更明白事理。

lines.en: : How about just...neither one of us talks until we have a drink in our hand. Cool?
lines.zh: : 不如这样……我们俩谁都不说话,直到手里有一杯酒。如何?

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: I take up Imani’s offer to remain quiet until we’re equipped with vials of liquid courage and revel in the return of a hastily departed silence.
lines.zh: 我接受了 Imani 的提议——在备好「液体勇气」之前保持沉默,并陶醉于这份仓促离场的沉默的回归。

lines.en: It doesn’t last long, however, as we know these roads like the backs of our hands and have navigated to this exact bar time and time again.
lines.zh: 但它没持续多久——我们对这些路熟得像自己的手背,一次又一次导航到这家一模一样的酒吧。

lines.en: Just never without anyone else.
lines.zh: 只是从来没试过不带别人。

lines.en: And confronting that will be fine for me-
lines.zh: 直面这一点,对我而言没问题——

lines.en: But will it be fine for Imani?
lines.zh: 可对 Imani 呢?

lines.en: Will she be able to overlook her innate desire to fuck me in the same way that I have taught myself how to bypass those urges and feelings in regard to her?
lines.zh: 她能像我已经教会自己绕开对她那些冲动和情感那样,无视她那想要上我的天性吗?

lines.en: Judging by her current demeanor, I’d say the answer is yes. I’d say that she can do that.
lines.zh: 看她此刻的举止,我会说答案是能。我会说她做得到。

lines.en: But I may very well just be giving her the benefit of the doubt because she’s smarter and older than the majority of girls I deal with on a daily basis.
lines.zh: 但我也有可能只是在给她信任的加分——毕竟,比起我日常打交道的多数女孩,她更聪明、更年长。

lines.en: It’s easy to look at people like them and predict their next moves because the majority of them are just as predictable as girls that age are meant to be.
lines.zh: 看她们那种人,预测下一步很容易——因为她们中的绝大多数,和这个年纪的女孩该有的样子一样好懂。

lines.en: But I still don’t know much about Imani.
lines.zh: 但我对 Imani 仍了解不多。

lines.en: I don’t know anything about the way she thinks because I’ve yet to learn what she thinks at all.
lines.zh: 我对她的思维方式一无所知——因为我还没弄清她到底在想什么。

lines.en: And all signs point to this being a good opportunity to learn, but...
lines.zh: 而一切迹象都表明,这是一个了解她的好机会,但是……

lines.en: : Senpai...
lines.zh: : Senpai……

lines.en: But I feel like we’re just going to wind up talking about me again.
lines.zh: 但我感觉,我们最后又会绕回聊我。

lines.en: : What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了?

lines.en: : This isn’t so bad...is it? Just you and me here, I mean.
lines.zh: : 这样感觉还不赖……是吧?只有你和我,我的意思是。

lines.en: : Did you expect it to be bad?
lines.zh: : 你以为会很糟?

lines.en: : No! It’s just, like...this is different. You know? We see each other all the time, but...the context of how we’re seeing each other makes things kind of...different. Ish.
lines.zh: : 不!只是,那个……这不一样。你懂吗?我们时常见面,但……「以什么方式见面」的语境,让事情变得有点……不同。算是吧。

lines.en: : I feel the same as always, pretty much.
lines.zh: : 我的感觉基本和平时一样。

lines.en: : Is that because...you’ve already got someone who kind of...twists your world into a giant knot?
lines.zh: : 那是因为……你已经有了某个把你世界拧成巨大绳结的人?

lines.en: : A little clarification would probably be nice right now. I'm not sure how to interpret that.
lines.zh: : 一点澄清大概会有帮助。我不确定该怎么解读。

lines.en: : I just mean, like...
lines.zh: : 我只是想说,比如……

lines.en: : Well, look at it this way. A lot of the time, when people talk about knots, it’s with some kind of...negative connotation.
lines.zh: : 嗯,这样看吧。很多时候,人们提到「结」,总是带着某种……负面的意味。

lines.en: : Like...oh. My stomach is “in knots.” Or...I feel all “knotted up” inside. But what about all of the times where knots are good?
lines.zh: : 比如……哦。我的胃「打了结」。或者……我内心「纠结成一团」。可「结」是好事的那些时刻呢?

lines.en: : Imani, how drunk are you right now?
lines.zh: : Imani,你现在醉到什么程度?

lines.en: : I am zero drunk, Senpai. We just got here. But, like...think about shoelaces. Or...shibari or something like that. There are a ton of situations where knots are a good thing.
lines.zh: : 我零醉,Senpai。我们才刚坐下。但是,比如……想想鞋带。或者……绳缚之类的。有很多情境,「结」是件好事。

lines.en: : They’re something that provides safety or security and...keeps shit in place.
lines.zh: : 它们提供安全、提供固定……让东西待在原地。

lines.en: : And, you know...frankly...
lines.zh: : 而且,你知道吗……坦白讲……

lines.en: : I can’t think of anything more “secure” than dating an idol.
lines.zh: : 我想不出比「和一位偶像约会」更「稳固」的事了。

lines.en: Here we go...
lines.zh: 来了……

lines.en: : Niki Nakayama...impressive.
lines.zh: : Niki Nakayama……了不起。

lines.en: : And here I thought you were going to marry her sister one day.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你打算有朝一日娶她妹妹呢。

lines.en: : Her sister is a teenage girl. Did you actually think I was planning on marrying her?
lines.zh: : 她妹妹是个十几岁的女孩。你真以为我在打算娶她?

lines.en: : No. I’m just not great at talking about heavy subjects and wind up using sarcasm as a backbone sometimes. Please forgive me, Senpai. I’m still learning.
lines.zh: : 不是。只是我不擅长谈沉重的话题,有时会拿讽刺当脊梁骨。请原谅我,Senpai。我还在学习。

lines.en: : Well, at least we’ve got that in common.
lines.zh: : 嗯,至少这一点我们有共识。

lines.en: : We’ve got a lot in common. Just I’m the one who winds up having to do all of the heavy lifting since I’m the extrovert here.
lines.zh: : 我们有共识的地方多了。只是因为我是这里的Extrovert,重活得全部由我来干。

lines.en: : The reality is though, Senpai...deep down, I don’t really want to be.
lines.zh: : 但现实是,Senpai……在内心深处,我并不想当那个人。

lines.en: : It’d be nice just relaxing and not having to worry about how everyone looks at me or...what everyone is thinking all the time, but I haven’t really figured out how to make that happen just yet.
lines.zh: : 能放松下来、不必时时刻刻在意每个人怎么看我、在想什么,那该多好——可我还没想明白怎么做到。

lines.en: : So instead, I keep things moving. Keep my expectations in line with the direction things are already flowing in and...just kind of...give things a push when they need to be pushed.
lines.zh: : 所以我干脆让事情流动。让我的期待顺着它们本来的流向,然后在需要推一把的时候……推一把。

lines.en: : Is this you telling me I need a “push?”
lines.zh: : 这是在暗示我需要「推一把」吗?

lines.en: : Not at all. I like you the way you are. I don’t think people have to be perfect or...even good for that matter.
lines.zh: : 完全不是。我就喜欢你现在的样子。我不认为人必须完美,或者……甚至必须「好」。

lines.en: : Like, don’t get me wrong- I’d be much quicker to tie myself to someone who doesn’t go around ruining everyone’s lives than someone who does-
lines.zh: : 就是说,别误会——比起一个到处毁掉别人人生的人,我当然更愿意和一个不毁别人人生的人绑定——

lines.en: : But I also think that reducing people to something as simplistic as the...history of their decisions concerning all things “morality” doesn’t paint the full picture.
lines.zh: : 但我也认为,把一个人简化成「他在一切道德议题上的决策史」这种东西,并不能画出完整的图景。

lines.en: : So...that wasn’t even remotely close to you telling me I need a push. You’re either just demonstrably bad at explaining things or I’m demonstrably bad at getting the point.
lines.zh: : 那么……这和你刚才否认的「我需要推一把」压根不沾边。要么你明显不擅长解释,要么我明显抓不住重点。

lines.en: : It’s probably me. What I’m really saying is that if I vibe with somebody, I’m more inclined to overlook any disagreements we have concerning moral alignments or...anything like that.
lines.zh: : 多半是我。我真正想说的是:如果我和某人合拍,我们就道德立场之类的分歧,我更愿意睁一只眼闭一只眼。

lines.en: : Sure, but...what does that have to do with Niki exactly? How did we get from her to this?
lines.zh: : 行,但是……那到底和 Niki 有什么关系?我们是怎么从她聊到这儿的?

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : I’ve got no fucking clue what I’m doing, Senpai.
lines.zh: : 我他妈完全不知道自己在干什么,Senpai。

lines.en: : It’s not even like I’m running in circles either. It’s like I’m lost somewhere in the middle of the track and I can’t even figure out how to get back onto it or...what direction I’m supposed to be running in.
lines.zh: : 我甚至不是在原地绕圈。更像是被困在跑道正中央的某处,连怎么回到跑道上都不知道,或者……该朝哪个方向跑。

lines.en: : But everyone seems to think it’ll just...click or something. Or they don’t realize I’m lost and assume I’m just pretending to be because it’ll make everyone laugh when...
lines.zh: : 可所有人似乎都觉得,一切会突然「开窍」什么的。或者他们根本没发现我迷路了,还以为我在装——因为那样能让所有人发笑,当……

lines.en: : When the truth is...I want someone to take my hand and show me where to go or...or get lost with me.
lines.zh: : 当真相是……我想要有人牵起我的手,告诉我该往哪走,或者……和我一起迷路。

lines.en: : I just haven’t figured out how to stop...reflexively pulling away any time someone tries to reach out just yet.
lines.zh: : 我只是还没学会,怎么在别人伸手的瞬间……不条件反射地缩回去。

lines.en: : If any of that sounded weird, you can just assume I’m already drunk.
lines.zh: : 刚才那些听着要是很怪,你就当我已经醉了。

lines.en: : All of it sounded a little weird, but I’m not going to do that. Especially since you haven't taken a single sip of your drink since you last told me you weren't drunk.
lines.zh: : 全都听起来有点怪,但我不会这么算。尤其你从上次声明「没醉」到现在,一口酒都没碰。

lines.en: : Instead, I’m just going to ask if you’re okay.
lines.zh: : 我反而只想问一句:你还好吗?

lines.en: : I think so. I’ve probably just thrown myself into rant-mode because we don’t ever really do things like this alone and I’m excited to finally get to...connect with you.
lines.zh: : 应该还好。我大概只是一头扎进了「长篇大论模式」——因为我们从来不单独做这种事,而我太兴奋了,终于能……和你真正连上线。

lines.en: : I’m just not sure if we’re really...connecting the way I want. You know?...
lines.zh: : 我只是不确定,我们是不是真的……在以我想要的方式连接。你懂吗?……

lines.en: : This...uh...
: Niki Nakayama...are you guys, like...
lines.zh: : Niki Nakayama……你们俩,那个……

lines.en: : What’s the deal?
lines.zh: : 到底怎么回事?

lines.en: Imani begins to play with the tab on her beer can, flicking it and bending it to compensate for the lack of sound inside the bar or to just...soothe some sort of mental craving she’s having right now.
lines.zh: Imani 开始摆弄啤酒罐的拉环,弹它、掰它——以弥补酒吧里声音的稀薄,或者只是为了……安抚她此刻的某种精神饥渴。

lines.en: I can’t say for sure as, again, I have no clue what her deal is. But, of course, we’re talking about me again.
lines.zh: 我说不准——毕竟,再强调一遍,我完全不知道她是怎么回事。但当然,我们又聊回了我。

lines.en: We’re talking about me because that’s all that ever happens and...and 99%% of the time, it’s all I want.
lines.zh: 我们聊我,因为永远只有这个节目可演,而且……百分之九十九的时候,这正是我想要的全部。

lines.en: But despite these tinted glasses that I’ve been peering through in order to see her, I want to know why she spends so much time agonizing over me when there is no reason to at all.
lines.zh: 可是,透过这副我一直在借以「看见她」的墨镜,我想知道:明明毫无理由,她为什么愿意花那么多时间为我辗转反侧。

lines.en: She doesn’t have to worry about Niki — she should worry about herself. About her dreams of helping children or the time she could spend on someone who doesn’t mind sacrificing a friendship.
lines.zh: : 她不必担心 Niki——她该担心的是她自己。担心她想帮助孩子的梦想,或者她本可以花在某个不介意牺牲一段友情的人身上的时间。

lines.en: : The deal is that I love her.
lines.zh: : 重点就是,我爱她。

lines.en: Her motions with the tab become more rapid...anxious. And I can sense that it’s only a few hard pulls from being snapped clean off of the aluminum.
lines.zh: 她拨弄拉环的动作变得急促……焦虑。我感觉得到,再用力拽几下,它就要从铝罐上干净利落地断开。

lines.en: : Do you want to hear more? Or does that suffice?
lines.zh: : 你还想听更多吗?还是这样就够了?

lines.en: : Is she good to you? She seemed a little...bossy.
lines.zh: : 她对你好吗?她看起来有点……强势。

lines.en: : She is. On both counts. Her bossiness is just a side effect of her archetype. In all actuality, she’s a very good person. And she cares about me more than I deserve.
lines.zh: : 她对我好。两者皆是。她的强势只是她这个人设的副产品。实际上,她是个非常好的人。而且她对我们的在乎,超出我应得的程度。

lines.en: : That’s not the answer you wanted to hear, was it?
lines.zh: : 那不是你想听到的答案,对吧?

lines.en: : I’m just happy you’re happy, Senpai. It sounds like you two are a good match.
lines.zh: : 我只是高兴你高兴,Senpai。听起来你们俩很相配。

lines.en: : I’m probably just not really understanding her yet. Maybe in time. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我多半只是还没真正理解她。也许假以时日。我不知道。

lines.en: : Do you want to understand her? Because she might be open to coming to the bar sometime, you know. I could always invite her.
lines.zh: : 你想理解她吗?你知道,她也许愿意哪天来酒吧坐坐。我可以去请她。

lines.en: : Yeah, I...don’t really want to get to know her.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我……并不想认识她。

lines.en: : Idols aren’t really my thing.
lines.zh: : 偶像不是我的菜。

lines.en: : I’m glad you’re happy, though. Seriously. You deserve it.
lines.zh: : 不过我很高兴你幸福。认真的。你值得。

lines.en: : Do I really, though?
lines.zh: : 我真的值得吗?

lines.en: : Yes...of course you do. Even if you’re corrupting the denizens of our poor classroom every single day, you’re still a human being. And we all deserve to feel loved in one way or another.
lines.zh: : 是……你当然值得。哪怕你每天都在腐化我们可怜教室里的居民,你仍然是个人。我们所有人,都值得以某种方式被爱。

lines.en: : Do you have anyone like that, Imani? Someone who makes you feel loved? And no, I’m not just speaking romantically. I mean in general.
lines.zh: : 你有这样一个人吗,Imani?让你感觉到被爱的人?不,我不是单指爱情。我是泛指。

lines.en: : Come on, Senpai. Do you really think I’d be acting like this if I did?
lines.zh: : 拜托,Senpai。你要真觉得我有,我还会是这副样子吗?

lines.en: : I haven’t had anyone like that in...years. And even then, I'm pretty sure I only believed I was loved and that...I’ve never really felt it the way you have.
lines.zh: : 我已经……好多年没有这样的人了。而且即便当年,我很确定我只是「相信」自己被爱,而……我从未像你那样真正感受过它。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for prying and...making you talk about stuff like your love life when we’re not really supposed to be doing that, but-
lines.zh: : 抱歉我打探隐私,还……让你谈感情生活这种本不该我们碰的话题,但是——

lines.en: : Do you really think I care about what we’re “supposed to be doing?”
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我在乎我们「该不该」做什么吗?

lines.en: : I told you because I wanted to tell you. I wanted to share a piece of myself with you because I want you to do the same for me. That’s what friends do. Probably.
lines.zh: : 我告诉你,是因为我想告诉你。我想把我的一片分给你,因为我希望你也为我做同样的事。朋友就是这样。大概吧。

lines.en: : Honestly, I don’t have very many- so I can’t confirm that.
lines.zh: : 说实话,我的朋友一只手数得过来——所以我没法证实这一点。

lines.en: : You and me both, Senpai.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此,Senpai。

lines.en: : That’s just one more reason I...like being with you so much.
lines.zh: : 这也是为什么我……这么喜欢和你在一起。

lines.en: : Are you...going to say anything else?
lines.zh: : 你……还要说什么吗?
: 不说了……

lines.en: : I was waiting to see what you’d do next.
lines.zh: : 我在等着看你下一步做什么。

lines.en: : But I think I get it now.
lines.zh: : 不过我想我现在懂了。

lines.en: : And I think I need another drink.
lines.zh: : 而且我想,我需要再来一杯。

lines.en: The tab on her beer can finally breaks off.
lines.zh: 啤酒罐的拉环终于断了。

lines.en: And just as it does, the silence returns.
lines.zh: 就在它断开的同一刻,沉默回来了。

lines.en: And the knots in my stomach protect me from nothing.
lines.zh: 而我胃里的那个结,什么也保护不了。

lines.en: Imani’s affection has increased to [imani_love]!
lines.zh: Imani 的好感度提升到了 [imani_love]!
